posts.text:
Sandbach face their first ever trip to the Red Lion Stadium to take on @breretonsocialf

Sandbach look to continue their good run of form having scored 14 goals in the last 3 games with back to back wins. Our opposition seek a first home win this season. Don't miss this one. https://t.co/NZm3LqGqd9
Next up for sponsorship is our little dynamo Jake Pollard @Pollard_93 Sponsored by Martyn Sanderson. Be sure to call him for any of your local heating and plumbing needs. https://t.co/34hW6Ts6K5

We Bring you a few new Sponsors this evening. We start with our number 9 Nathan Barry who has kindly been sponsored by club stalwart and long term member Gary Cooke. Thank you for your support Cookie. 💙🤍 https://t.co/jOo0Xfyv05
Dec and JKD review today’s emphatic 6 0 win against Widnes in rather wet conditions at Hind Heath Road. https://t.co/plsWMkmfWu
Kyle Foley talks us through his two goals and his unlikely header, as The Bach put 6 past Widnes today at Hind Heath Road https://t.co/YjLBOXxAhh

🔵⚪️ v 🟡🟡

FT here and The Bach run out comprehensive 6 0 winners against 10 man Widnes with goals from Kyle Foley 2, Kieran O’Connell, Stan Tatters, Nathan Barry and Robbie Hatton. Some delightful football and countless chances created, well done and get in, super 6 Saturday!
